info.name: GitSink GraphQL API
info.description: GraphQL API collection for GitSink - includes all queries, mutations, and subscriptions for the frontend integration.

graphql.query:
query GetProjects {
  projects {
    id
    title
    description
    repoUrl
    platform
    language
    starCount
    forkCount
    tags
    category
    featured
    published
    isPrivate
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

graphql.query:
query MyProfile {
  myProfile {
    id
    userId
    username
    displayName
    bio
    avatar
    location
    website
    isPublic
    viewCount
    socialLinks {
      platform
      url
      label
    }
    theme {
      primaryColor
      secondaryColor
      fontFamily
      backgroundStyle
    }
    settings {
      isPublic
      showEmail
      showStats
      showActivity
      showContributions
      showPrivateRepos
      layout
      featuredProjects
    }
    stats {
      totalProjects
      publicProjects
      totalStars

graphql.query:
query AuditLogs($limit: Float!, $offset: Float!, $actions: [AuditAction!], $resources: [AuditResource!]) {
  auditLogs(limit: $limit, offset: $offset, actions: $actions, resources: $resources) {
    totalCount
    hasNextPage
    hasPreviousPage
    nodes {
      id
      action
      actionDescription
      resource
      resourceId
      resourceName
      resourceDescription
      userId
      userName
      success
      error
      ipAddress
      userAgent
      details
      detailsFormatted
      timestamp
    }
  }
}

query SyncHistory($limit: Float, $offset: Float, $projectId: String) {
  syncHistory(limit: $limit, offset: $offset, projectId: $projectId) {
    totalCount
    hasNextPage
    hasPreviousPage
    nodes {
      id
      userId
      userName
      projectId
      projectTitle
      repositoryUrl
      platform
      operation
      operationDescription
      status
      statusDescription
      startedAt
      completedAt
      duration
      durationFormatted
      error
      metadata
      changes {
        changeType
        field
        oldValue
        newValue
      }
    }
  }
}

query SandboxRepositories {
  sandboxRepositories {
    id
    name
    fullName
    description
    htmlUrl
    cloneUrl
    defaultBranch
    language
    topics
    starCount
    forkCount
    isPrivate
    platform
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
